name: Sangetsu Corporation
summary: Sangetsu Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, development, manufacture, sale, and installation of interior decorating products in Japan and internationally. It operates through the Domestic Interior, Domestic Exterior, and Overseas segments. The Domestic Interior segment is involved in the planning, manufacture, and sale of wallcoverings, flooring materials, fabrics, and other interior design materials, as well as space creation, design, and construction. Its Domestic Exterior segment offers exterior products, such as gates, fences, and carports, as well as design proposals and construction for exterior spaces.
